rows.note: Use 施加 as the all-purpose choice for applying a restriction, pressure, duty, or other burden; it does not specifically mean collecting a tax.

example.english: We impose heavy penalties on shops that break the rules.
example.traditional: 我哋會向違規店舖施加重罰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 hoeng3 wai4 kwai1 dim3 pou3 si1 gaa1 cung5 fat6

rows.note: Use 徵收 specifically when an authority collects a tax, fee, or other levy.

example.english: The government will impose a waste disposal fee starting next month.
example.traditional: 政府下個月開始徵收垃圾處理費。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 haa5 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 zing1 sau1 laap6 saap3 cyu2 lei5 fai3

rows.note: Use 麻煩 when imposing on or inconveniencing a person, as in saying you do not want to trouble someone.

example.english: Sorry to impose on you again and ask you to look after my cat.
example.traditional: 唔好意思，今次又要麻煩你幫我睇住隻貓。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 gam1 ci3 jau6 jiu3 maa4 faan4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 zek3 maau1
